task.question: How many years after retiring following the 2022 Beijing Games did Alysa Liu launch her comeback, per ESPN?
task.evidence: Liu retired after the 2022 Beijing Games only to launch a triumphant comeback two years later.
task.page: Olympic champ Alysa Liu withdraws from figure skating worlds

answer:
Alysa Liu retired after the 2022 Beijing Games and launched her comeback in 2023. This means she came back one year after retiring.

FINAL: 1
